visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Zoe, a young woman with dark hair and bangs wearing a textured pink sweater, speaks to the camera in a medium close-up. She holds a small pink Minnie Mouse plush toy. The background is a simple gray wall. Rapid cuts show black SUVs driving along a winding, snow-covered road in a vast, bright winter landscape. (2) Returning to the indoor setting, Zoe leans forward and gestures with her hand near her mouth as if sharing a secret. Large white text overlays "大錯特錯!" and "省!" appear prominently. She shifts her body slightly and points her index finger upward to emphasize her point while holding the plush. (3) Zoe holds up two specific credit cards—one green and one white CUBE card—bringing them right up to the camera lens for a detailed view. Her facial expression is bright and informative. The lighting is very bright and professional, highlighting the details of the cards and her sweater's knit texture. (4) Zoe displays her smartphone screen which shows the Google Flight search and price tracking interface. She uses her free hand to point at the screen's data points while maintaining eye contact with the viewer. The background remains the consistent, dimly lit but clean indoor room with the gray headboard visible. (5) A transition graphic with the text "第三步: SHOPBACK" and a red lightning bolt icon appears. Zoe holds her phone showing the Shopback mobile app. Several digital logos for travel brands like Booking.com, Agoda, and Klook appear as animated overlays floating around her, and she gestures toward them excitedly. (6) High-definition screenshots of the app's "Cashback" page are shown, highlighting a total balance of NT$42,101 in large orange numbers. Zoe appears in a small inset or corner of the screen, pointing at the figure with a very surprised and happy facial expression, her eyes wide. (7) Action camera b-roll shows Zoe and a male partner in full black motorcycle gear riding on wide highways and through picturesque winding mountain passes in Europe. The scenery features lush green hills and distant snow-capped peaks. Screenshots of specific cashback records for hotel bookings are superimposed over the scenic footage. (8) In the final segment, Zoe is back in the medium shot, waving enthusiastically at the camera. She holds her phone and the Minnie Mouse plush toy. A large text box at the bottom provides instructions and a promo code "肉比頭." She finishes with a bright, confident smile and a small fist-pump gesture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female narration starts. Pitch is bright, tone enthusiastic. BGM is upbeat electronic pop (128 BPM) with steady synth chords and percussion. (2) A sharp "whoosh" SFX triggers as the scene cuts to snowy travel b-roll. Vocal intensity remains high as she asks a rhetorical question about money. (3) Speech tone shifts to a playful "secret" whisper style. BGM continues at a constant volume. No ambient noise is audible in this indoor recording environment. (4) A distinct digital "ding" sound occurs as the first credit card graphic appears. Narration is fast-paced (speed rate 4/5) with clear, professional enunciation of financial terms. (5) Another "ding" sounds as the second card is mentioned. The interplay between the rhythmic BGM and the speaker's rising intonation creates a highly engaging acoustic flow. (6) A "pop" SFX triggers as the phone screen interface is shown. The speaker's volume is consistent, reflecting a well-compressed studio-style vocal track with high clarity. (7) A prominent "whoosh" marks the start of the "Step 3" segment. The BGM maintains energy with a percussive electronic texture and melodic synth lines in a major mode. (8) Multiple "chime" sounds occur in rapid succession as various travel platform logos appear. The vocal speech density is high, with few pauses between the listed brand names. (9) A loud "cash register" bell SFX triggers when the specific cashback balance is mentioned. The speaker's arousal level is high (8/9), conveying significant excitement and positivity. (10) A sharp "impact" sound effect punctuates the mention of the 20% discount. The spectral centroid is bright, dominated by high-frequency vocal clarity and crisp electronic percussion. (11) A melodic "whoosh" transition leads into the motorcycle b-roll. Faint, high-frequency wind noise is briefly detectable as an ambient layer beneath the dominant BGM and narration. (12) A final "whoosh" sound effect triggers as the speaker returns to the main frame for the outro. The vocal delivery is authoritative yet friendly, emphasizing the call to action. (13) A digital UI "ping" sound highlights the appearance of the promo code text. The audio track ends with a clean fade-out of the BGM following the final spoken phrase.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Step 1 (Credit Cards) -> Step 2 (Flight Tracking) -> Step 3 (Cashback App) -> Case Study/Proof -> CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an informative travel-hacking guide aimed at budget-conscious travelers. It leverages the creator's personal success (earning 40k+ cashback) to endorse the Shopback app and other financial strategies, combining lifestyle vlog elements with a clear promotional call to action using a personalized invitation code.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct recommendation of the app, display of specific cashback earnings, and provision of a promotional invitation code for savings.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly polished, fast-paced vertical video designed for social media. It successfully blends personal travel experiences with practical utility to drive app conversions.
